content: PartyKit deployment guide (docs.partykit.io/guides/deploy-to-cloudflare): default managed platform requires no Cloudflare account; cloud-prem deploys to the developer's own Cloudflare account/domain via env vars + PartyKit CLI, needed for regulatory requirements or to fold into existing Cloudflare infra. Cloud-prem is free at the PartyKit layer; cost is Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects usage only.
